title: 東京晴空塔~Tokyo Skytree
focus: 三角形鋼管桁架塔身、獨立鋼筋混凝土心柱與油壓阻尼的「心柱制振」，以及節狀壁樁基礎如何支撐 634 m 電波塔~How a triangular tubular steel truss, an independent concrete central column with oil dampers and knuckle-wall foundations carry a 634 m broadcasting tower
summary: 從三角形基底到圓形頂部的塔身斷面與格構風力出發，理解心柱與鋼塔之間以油壓阻尼器耦合的減振機制，計算直徑 2.3 m 鋼管與節狀壁樁的容量，再處理日照彎曲下的施工測量、在中央豎井內頂升天線塔、阻尼器的雙線性特性驗證、2011 年地震時施工中塔體的檢查，最後是冬季落冰與鋼管塔的防蝕維護。~Starting from the tower's triangle-to-circle section and the wind force on an open lattice, understand how the central column and steel tower are coupled through oil dampers to reduce vibration, compute the capacity of 2.3 m steel tubes and knuckle-wall piles, then handle construction surveys under solar bowing, lifting the antenna mast inside the central shaft, verifying bilinear damper behaviour, inspecting the unfinished tower after the 2011 earthquake, and finally falling ice and corrosion upkeep of a tubular steel tower.

units.anchor: 三角形到圓形的斷面~Triangle-to-circle section
units.title: 三角形基底、圓形頂部與格構風力~Triangular base, circular top and wind on a lattice
units.mechanism: 東京晴空塔底部是邊長約 68 m 的正三角形，三支腳柱向上逐漸收攏，斷面由三角形轉為圓形，約在 350 m 以上成為圓筒狀；高度與底寬比約 9：1，是極為細長的獨立塔。三角形基底在狹窄基地內提供最大的力臂與穩定性，圓形上部則讓不同風向的阻力較一致。塔身是鋼管桁架而非實心外牆，風力取決於桿件的投影面積與實積率，而不是整個輪廓面積。~Tokyo Skytree stands on an equilateral triangle with sides of about 68 m; its three legs draw together as they rise, so the section changes from a triangle to a circle and becomes cylindrical above about 350 m. Its height-to-base ratio is about 9 to 1, making it an extremely slender free-standing tower. The triangular base gives the largest lever arm and stability on a narrow site, while the circular upper section makes drag more uniform across wind directions. The body is a tubular steel truss rather than a solid skin, so wind force depends on member projected area and solidity ratio rather than on the whole outline.
units.model: 格構塔單位高度風力 F = q·C_f·φ·B。風速 40 m/s 時 q = ½×1.225×40² ≈ 980 Pa；取 C_f = 2.0、實積率 φ = 0.25、外輪廓寬 B = 40 m，F = 980×2.0×0.25×40 ≈ 19.6 kN/m；若沿 600 m 均布，基底彎矩約 19.6×600²/2 ≈ 3.5 GN·m。細長比 634/68 ≈ 9.3。風速與係數為教學假設。~Wind force per unit height on a lattice tower F = q·C_f·φ·B. At 40 m/s, q = ½×1.225×40² ≈ 980 Pa; with C_f = 2.0, solidity φ = 0.25 and outline width B = 40 m, F = 980×2.0×0.25×40 ≈ 19.6 kN/m, and spread over 600 m the base moment is about 19.6×600²/2 ≈ 3.5 GN·m. The slenderness is 634/68 ≈ 9.3. Wind speed and coefficients are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以風洞試驗量測不同高度斷面的阻力係數與實積率影響，並確認圓形段沒有明顯的渦流共振；分析模型要逐段輸入桿件投影面積，與風洞結果比較基底剪力與彎矩，並檢查天線、維修平台等附掛物增加的受風面積。~Measure drag coefficients and solidity effects for sections at different heights in the wind tunnel and confirm that the circular segment shows no marked vortex resonance; enter member projected areas segment by segment in the analysis model, compare base shear and moment with the wind-tunnel results, and account for added area from antennas and maintenance platforms.
units.failure: 若後續加裝天線、照明或廣告物而未重新計算受風面積，實積率上升會讓風力超出設計；圓形段若出現渦流共振，細長的上部會產生持續擺動，對天線與連接件造成疲勞。~Adding antennas, lighting or signage later without recalculating wind area raises the solidity and pushes wind force beyond design; vortex resonance in the circular segment would make the slender top sway persistently, fatiguing antennas and connections.
units.misconception: 格構塔透風，所以風力可以忽略。~A lattice tower lets the wind through, so wind force can be ignored.
units.practice: 建立附掛物登錄制度：任何新增天線、燈具或設備都要登錄投影面積與重量，由結構工程師確認累計值仍在設計範圍內，才可安裝。~Set up a register of attachments: every new antenna, light or device records its projected area and weight, and installation proceeds only after the structural engineer confirms the cumulative total is within design.

units.title: 心柱與鋼塔的相位差減振~Out-of-phase damping between central column and tower
units.mechanism: 塔的中央是一根直徑約 8 m 的鋼筋混凝土圓筒心柱，內設逃生樓梯，高度約到 375 m，與外側鋼塔在結構上分離。心柱在約 125 m 以下與鋼塔固結，125 m 至 375 m 之間則以油壓阻尼器連接；地震或強風時心柱與鋼塔的週期不同，擺動出現相位差，阻尼器在兩者的相對運動中消耗能量。設計概念取自五重塔的中心柱，公開資料稱可減少地震反應約 40% 至 50%。~At the centre stands a reinforced concrete cylinder about 8 m in diameter, housing an escape stair and rising to about 375 m, structurally separate from the outer steel tower. The column is fixed to the tower below about 125 m and connected by oil dampers between 125 m and 375 m; in an earthquake or strong wind the column and tower have different periods and sway out of phase, so the dampers dissipate energy in their relative motion. The concept is drawn from the central pillar of five-storey pagodas, and public sources state seismic response reductions of about 40% to 50%.
units.model: 阻尼器力 F = c·Δv，Δv = 2π·f·Δx。若兩者相對位移振幅 Δx = 0.10 m、頻率 f = 0.3 Hz，Δv ≈ 0.188 m/s；阻尼係數 c = 5,000 kN·s/m 時 F ≈ 942 kN，每循環消耗能量 E = π·c·ω·Δx² ≈ π×5,000×1.885×0.01 ≈ 296 kJ。數值為教學假設。~Damper force F = c·Δv with Δv = 2π·f·Δx. For a relative amplitude Δx = 0.10 m at f = 0.3 Hz, Δv ≈ 0.188 m/s; with c = 5,000 kN·s/m, F ≈ 942 kN, and the energy dissipated per cycle is E = π·c·ω·Δx² ≈ π×5,000×1.885×0.01 ≈ 296 kJ. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以時間歷程分析比較有無阻尼器連接時的頂部加速度、基底剪力與兩者相對位移，確認相對位移落在阻尼器行程內；也要檢查心柱與鋼塔的週期比，若兩者太接近就不會產生足夠的相位差。~Compare top acceleration, base shear and relative displacement with and without the damper connection in time-history analyses, confirming relative displacement stays within damper stroke; also check the period ratio of column and tower, since periods too close together will not produce enough phase difference.
units.failure: 若心柱與鋼塔之間的淨空不足，大地震時兩者可能碰撞；阻尼器若漏油或卡死，心柱會變成單純的附加質量或剛性連接，減振效果消失，甚至在某些頻率放大反應。~Insufficient clearance between column and tower can let them collide in a major earthquake; if dampers leak or seize, the column becomes mere added mass or a rigid link, the damping benefit disappears and response may even amplify at some frequencies.
units.misconception: 心柱是用來支撐鋼塔重量的主柱。~The central column is the main column that carries the steel tower's weight.
units.practice: 心柱與鋼塔的相對位移、阻尼器行程與淨空要在同一張圖上管理，任何在兩者之間新增的管線或平台都必須保留滑動或可撓接頭；阻尼器的型號、數量與試驗資料列入交接文件。~Manage relative displacement, damper stroke and clearance between column and tower on one drawing, require any new services or platforms bridging the gap to keep sliding or flexible joints, and include damper models, numbers and test data in the handover documents.

units.anchor: 直徑 2.3 m 鋼管~2.3 m diameter steel tubes
units.title: 高強度鋼管構材與分歧接頭~High-strength tubular members and branch joints
units.mechanism: 晴空塔的主要構材用鋼管而非 H 型鋼，主要接頭以焊接的分歧接頭（管對管直接相貫）組成，以減輕重量並提高耐震性；最粗的鋼管直徑約 2.3 m、厚約 10 cm，公開資料指出單根約 29 公噸，並使用約為一般鋼材兩倍強度的高強度鋼。圓管在各方向的抗彎與抗挫屈性能相同，受風面積也較小；但相貫接頭的應力集中明顯，焊接幾何與熱影響區的韌性是設計重點。~Skytree's main members are steel tubes rather than H-sections, joined mostly by welded branch joints where tube meets tube directly, to save weight and improve seismic performance; the largest tubes are about 2.3 m in diameter and about 10 cm thick, one such piece weighing about 29 t according to public sources, in high-strength steel of roughly twice ordinary strength. A circular tube has equal bending and buckling resistance in every direction and less wind area, but stress concentrations at intersecting joints are pronounced, so weld geometry and heat-affected-zone toughness are key design concerns.
units.model: 鋼管面積 A = π·(D − t)·t = π×2.2×0.1 ≈ 0.691 m²，每公尺重 0.691×7,850 ≈ 5,430 kg，29 t 的構材長約 5.3 m；以降伏強度 630 MPa 計，全斷面降伏軸力約 0.691×630 ≈ 435 MN。徑厚比 D/t = 23，屬局部挫屈不易發生的厚實斷面。強度為教學假設。~Tube area A = π·(D − t)·t = π×2.2×0.1 ≈ 0.691 m², about 5,430 kg per metre, so a 29 t piece is about 5.3 m long; at a yield strength of 630 MPa the squash load is about 0.691×630 ≈ 435 MN. With D/t = 23 the section is stocky and unlikely to buckle locally. The strength is a teaching assumption.
units.verify: 分歧接頭以有限元素分析求熱點應力，並以縮尺或足尺試體驗證應力集中係數與疲勞強度；工廠焊接全數做超音波檢測，厚板焊接記錄預熱與層間溫度，鋼材以夏比衝擊試驗確認低溫韌性。~Obtain hot-spot stresses at branch joints by finite-element analysis and verify stress concentration factors and fatigue strength on scaled or full-size specimens; ultrasonically test all shop welds, record preheat and interpass temperatures for thick welds, and confirm low-temperature toughness of the steel by Charpy impact tests.
units.failure: 相貫接頭若焊趾成形不良或有未熔合，風致反覆應力會在熱點處引發疲勞裂縫；高強度鋼若焊接熱輸入控制不當，熱影響區變脆，地震時可能在接頭附近脆性斷裂。~Poor weld-toe profiles or lack of fusion at intersecting joints let repeated wind stresses start fatigue cracks at hot spots; poorly controlled heat input on high-strength steel embrittles the heat-affected zone, risking brittle fracture near joints in an earthquake.
units.misconception: 鋼管越粗越厚就越安全，接頭細節不重要。~The bigger and thicker the tube, the safer it is; joint details do not matter.
units.practice: 每一個分歧接頭要有焊接程序書、熱點應力計算與檢測紀錄，焊趾修整列為檢驗項目；高強度鋼的焊材、熱輸入範圍與預熱溫度由材料與焊接工程師共同簽認。~Give every branch joint a welding procedure, hot-spot stress calculation and inspection record, with weld-toe dressing as an inspection item; consumables, heat-input range and preheat for the high-strength steel are signed off jointly by the materials and welding engineers.

units.title: 節狀連續壁樁的摩擦與拉拔~Friction and uplift in knuckle wall piles
units.mechanism: 晴空塔建在隅田川附近的沖積地層上，三支腳柱下方採用節狀壁樁（knuckle wall），以場鑄混凝土壁樁深入地下約 50 m，壁面每隔一段設突出的「節」，並以放射狀相互連結。節像錨一樣嵌入土層，同時增加下壓時的承壓面與上拔時的抵抗面；三角形配置使強風或地震時迎風腳可能減壓甚至受拉，所以基礎的拉拔能力與下壓能力同樣重要。~Skytree stands on alluvial ground near the Sumida River, and beneath its three legs are knuckle wall piles: cast-in-place concrete wall piles reaching about 50 m deep, with projecting knuckles at intervals along the wall and radial interconnection. The knuckles key into the soil like anchors, adding bearing area in compression and resisting area in uplift; because the triangular layout can unload or even lift the windward leg in strong wind or earthquakes, the foundation's uplift capacity matters as much as its compressive capacity.
units.model: 壁樁容量 Q = 周長×L×f_s + Σ節承壓。壁段 1.2 m × 6 m（周長 14.4 m）、L = 50 m、f_s = 80 kPa：側摩擦 14.4×50×0.08 = 57.6 MN；3 個節各外凸 0.4 m，承壓面積 0.4×14.4 = 5.76 m²、承壓 1.5 MPa，各約 8.6 MN，合計約 25.9 MN；總容量約 83.5 MN。數值為教學假設。~Wall-pile capacity Q = perimeter×L×f_s + Σ knuckle bearing. For a 1.2 m × 6 m panel (14.4 m perimeter), L = 50 m and f_s = 80 kPa, side friction is 14.4×50×0.08 = 57.6 MN; three knuckles each projecting 0.4 m give 0.4×14.4 = 5.76 m² of bearing at 1.5 MPa, about 8.6 MN each or 25.9 MN together, for a total of about 83.5 MN. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以試驗樁做下壓與拉拔載重試驗，量測節的貢獻與側摩擦分布；施工時以超音波量測壁槽形狀，確認節的位置與尺寸符合設計，並記錄穩定液性質與混凝土澆置量，比對理論體積以發現坍孔或縮頸。~Load-test trial piles in compression and uplift to measure the knuckle contribution and side-friction distribution; during construction profile the trench ultrasonically to confirm knuckle position and size, and log slurry properties and concrete volume against theoretical volume to detect collapse or necking.
units.failure: 若節的開挖尺寸不足或被坍落土填塞，節的承壓貢獻大減，拉拔容量可能遠低於設計；放射狀連結若在施工縫處接合不良，三支腳柱的基礎無法共同作用，差異沉陷與傾斜風險增加。~If knuckles are under-excavated or filled with collapsed soil, their bearing contribution drops sharply and uplift capacity can fall far below design; poor joints in the radial interconnection keep the three leg foundations from acting together, raising the risk of differential settlement and tilt.
units.misconception: 塔很重，所以基礎只需要考慮下壓，不會受拉。~The tower is heavy, so its foundation only needs to resist compression and never tension.
units.practice: 每片壁樁的開挖斷面量測、節位置照片與澆置紀錄要逐片歸檔；拉拔試驗結果未達標前，不得進行腳柱基礎的上部施工，此為結構設計者簽認的停止點。~File trench profile measurements, knuckle position photographs and placement records panel by panel; superstructure work on a leg foundation must not start until uplift test results meet the criteria, a hold point signed by the structural designer.

units.anchor: 日照彎曲與施工測量~Solar bowing and construction survey
units.title: 細長塔身的日照彎曲與施工測量~Solar bowing and surveying a slender tower
units.mechanism: 634 m 的細長鋼塔在日照下，向陽面鋼材升溫伸長、背陰面較冷，整個塔身會向背陽側彎曲，頂部偏移可達數十公分，並隨太陽方位在一天內移動。施工中每一段鋼管都要依座標安裝，若在日照強烈時測量並修正，等塔身冷卻後就會偏向另一側。因此測量必須在溫度均勻的時段（例如清晨）進行，或以溫度感測器即時修正，並把風造成的擺動另外扣除。~Under sunshine, a 634 m slender steel tower heats and lengthens on its sunny side while the shaded side stays cooler, so the whole body bows away from the sun with top movements that can reach tens of centimetres, shifting with the sun's bearing through the day. Every tube segment must be set to coordinates during erection, and surveying and correcting under strong sun leaves the tower leaning the other way once it cools. Surveys must therefore be done when temperatures are uniform, such as early morning, or corrected in real time with temperature sensors, with wind sway removed separately.
units.model: 溫差彎曲頂部偏移 δ = α·ΔT·H²/(2B)。α = 12×10⁻⁶ /°C、兩側溫差 ΔT = 10 °C、施工高度 H = 400 m、該段寬度 B = 40 m，δ = 12×10⁻⁶×10×400²/(2×40) ≈ 0.24 m；溫差減為 3 °C 時偏移約 0.07 m。數值為教學假設。~Top offset from thermal bowing δ = α·ΔT·H²/(2B). With α = 12×10⁻⁶ /°C, a 10 °C difference across the section, a construction height H = 400 m and width B = 40 m, δ = 12×10⁻⁶×10×400²/(2×40) ≈ 0.24 m; at a 3 °C difference the offset is about 0.07 m. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 在塔身不同高度與方位設置溫度計與全球衛星定位接收器，建立溫差與頂部偏移的關係；每段鋼構安裝後於清晨無風時複測座標，與施工階段分析預測的形狀（含自重與溫度）比較，確認偏差在容許範圍內才可進行下一段。~Install thermometers and satellite-positioning receivers at several heights and orientations to correlate temperature difference with top offset; after each segment is erected, resurvey coordinates in calm early-morning conditions and compare with the shape predicted by construction-stage analysis including self-weight and temperature, proceeding only when deviations are within tolerance.
units.failure: 若在午後量測並依此修正，塔身冷卻後會偏離設計軸線，累積到上部時天線塔可能無法對準中央豎井；三支腳柱若各自以不同時段的測量資料修正，塔身會出現扭轉誤差。~Correcting from afternoon surveys leaves the tower off its design axis once it cools, and by the upper levels the antenna mast may no longer align with the central shaft; correcting each of the three legs from surveys taken at different times introduces a twist error into the tower.
units.misconception: 鋼構安裝只要每段都對準設計座標，量測時間不重要。~As long as each segment is set to design coordinates, the time of surveying does not matter.
units.practice: 測量程序書要規定量測時段、溫差上限與風速上限，所有修正量由測量主管與結構工程師共同核可；三支腳柱必須在同一時段量測，資料保留以供日後完工形狀比對。~The survey procedure fixes measurement windows, maximum temperature difference and maximum wind speed, with all corrections approved jointly by the survey lead and the structural engineer; survey the three legs in the same window and keep the data for later comparison with the as-built shape.

units.title: 在中央豎井內組裝並頂升天線塔~Assembling and lifting the antenna mast inside the shaft
units.mechanism: 晴空塔頂部的天線塔（gain tower）外徑約 6 m，並未用塔吊一節一節吊到 600 m 以上，而是在塔身中央的豎井內由下往上組裝，連同避雷設施與兩組合計約 100 公噸的調諧質量阻尼器，逐段頂升推出塔頂。2010 年 12 月開始在豎井內逐步上推，2011 年 3 月達到 634 m。豎井內頂升避免了在極高處以塔吊吊裝大型構件，也讓高空作業轉移到有遮蔽的豎井內；代價是頂升期間塔身要承受天線塔的移動荷重與導引反力。~The antenna mast, or gain tower, at the top of Skytree is about 6 m in outside diameter. Rather than being lifted piece by piece by crane above 600 m, it was assembled inside the central shaft from below and jacked upward in stages, carrying lightning protection and two tuned mass dampers totalling about 100 t, until it emerged at the top. Lifting inside the shaft began in December 2010 and the mast reached 634 m in March 2011. Lifting within the shaft avoided crane lifts of large members at extreme height and moved work at height into a sheltered shaft, at the cost of the tower carrying the mast's moving load and guide reactions during the lift.
units.model: 頂升荷重分配：若天線塔連同附屬設備重 3,000 t，W = 3,000×9.81 ≈ 29.4 MN，由 6 具千斤頂分擔各約 4.9 MN；計入 1.25 動力與不均勻係數後約 6.1 MN，選用 8 MN 千斤頂時使用率約 77%。若行程 0.5 m、需推升 130 m，約 260 個循環。數值為教學假設。~Jacking load sharing: if the mast with its equipment weighs 3,000 t, W = 3,000×9.81 ≈ 29.4 MN, about 4.9 MN on each of 6 jacks; with a 1.25 factor for dynamics and unevenness this is about 6.1 MN, a utilisation of about 77% on 8 MN jacks. With a 0.5 m stroke, a 130 m lift needs about 260 cycles. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 頂升前以施工階段分析檢查各頂升位置時塔身的應力與變形，千斤頂壓力以同步控制系統即時監測，各點荷重差異超過設定值即停止；每次頂升後量測天線塔的垂直度與導引間隙，並在強風預報時停止頂升並鎖定。~Before jacking, check tower stresses and deformation at each lift position with construction-stage analysis, monitor jack pressures in real time through a synchronised control system, and stop when load differences between points exceed the set value; after each lift measure mast verticality and guide clearances, stopping and locking whenever strong winds are forecast.
units.failure: 若各千斤頂不同步，天線塔會傾斜並卡在導引上，造成導引構件與塔身局部超載；頂升中遭遇強風而未鎖定時，部分伸出的天線塔像懸臂受風，根部彎矩可能超過臨時支承的容量。~If the jacks fall out of sync, the mast tilts and jams in its guides, locally overloading guide members and the tower; if it is not locked when strong wind arrives mid-lift, the partly extended mast acts as a cantilever in the wind and its root moment can exceed the temporary supports' capacity.
units.misconception: 在豎井內頂升比較安全，所以不需要另做結構分析。~Lifting inside the shaft is safer, so no separate structural analysis is needed.
units.practice: 頂升計畫要列出每一段的荷重、千斤頂壓力上限、同步誤差容許值、風速停工條件與鎖定程序；每次頂升開始前設停止點，由頂升工程師與結構工程師共同確認後才可啟動。~The lifting plan lists the load at each stage, jack-pressure limits, allowable synchronisation error, wind stop limits and locking procedure; set a hold point before every lift so it starts only after the lifting engineer and structural engineer jointly confirm.

units.anchor: 油壓阻尼器的雙線性特性~Bilinear oil-damper behaviour
units.title: 心柱油壓阻尼器的性能驗證~Verifying the central-column oil dampers
units.mechanism: 連接心柱與鋼塔的油壓阻尼器必須在中小振動時提供足夠阻尼，又不能在大地震時產生過大的力而損壞心柱或鋼塔接頭。常見做法是加裝釋壓閥，使阻尼器呈雙線性：速度低於某一門檻時阻尼力與速度成正比，超過門檻後阻尼係數大幅降低，力量只緩慢增加。驗證的重點是確認實際產品的門檻速度、兩段阻尼係數與溫度影響，與分析模型使用的參數一致。~The oil dampers linking the central column and steel tower must provide enough damping in small and moderate vibrations without generating forces large enough in a major earthquake to damage the column or tower connections. A common solution is a relief valve that makes the damper bilinear: below a threshold velocity force is proportional to velocity, and above it the damping coefficient drops sharply so force rises only slowly. Verification focuses on confirming that the actual units' threshold velocity, two damping coefficients and temperature sensitivity match the parameters used in the analysis model.
units.model: 雙線性阻尼 F = c₁·v（v ≤ v_r），F = c₁·v_r + c₂·(v − v_r)（v > v_r）。取 c₁ = 10,000 kN·s/m、v_r = 0.1 m/s、c₂ = 1,000 kN·s/m：v = 0.3 m/s 時 F = 1,000 + 1,000×0.2 = 1,200 kN，若無釋壓閥則為 3,000 kN，接頭設計力可降低六成。數值為教學假設。~Bilinear damping: F = c₁·v for v ≤ v_r and F = c₁·v_r + c₂·(v − v_r) for v > v_r. With c₁ = 10,000 kN·s/m, v_r = 0.1 m/s and c₂ = 1,000 kN·s/m, at v = 0.3 m/s F = 1,000 + 1,000×0.2 = 1,200 kN, versus 3,000 kN without a relief valve, cutting the connection design force by 60%. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 每一具阻尼器出廠前以動態試驗機做正弦加載，涵蓋門檻速度上下的多個速度與溫度，繪出力—速度曲線並與規格允差比較；安裝後檢查固定端螺栓預力、油位與行程指示，並把序號與試驗結果對應存檔。~Before delivery, test every damper on a dynamic rig with sinusoidal loading at several velocities above and below the threshold and at several temperatures, plotting force–velocity curves against the specified tolerance; after installation check end-connection bolt preload, oil level and stroke indicators, and file serial numbers against test results.
units.failure: 釋壓閥設定過高時，大地震中阻尼器力量超出接頭容量，可能拉壞心柱的埋件；設定過低則中小地震時阻尼不足，心柱制振效果打折。密封老化漏油會使兩段阻尼係數同時下降。~A relief valve set too high lets damper force exceed connection capacity in a major earthquake, possibly tearing out embeds in the column; set too low, it leaves too little damping in moderate earthquakes and weakens the central-column scheme. Ageing seals that leak oil lower both damping coefficients.
units.misconception: 阻尼器的力量越大越好，不需要限制。~The larger a damper's force the better, so it needs no limit.
units.practice: 採購規範要寫明門檻速度、兩段阻尼係數、溫度範圍內的變化上限與逐具試驗要求；心柱與鋼塔接頭的設計力須以阻尼器可能的最大力（含製造允差）計算，並由結構設計者確認。~The procurement specification states the threshold velocity, both damping coefficients, the maximum variation over the temperature range and unit-by-unit testing; design the column and tower connections for the damper's maximum possible force including manufacturing tolerance, confirmed by the structural designer.

units.anchor: 施工中強震後檢查~Post-earthquake inspection during construction
units.title: 2011 年地震時施工中塔體的檢查~Inspecting the unfinished tower after the 2011 earthquake
units.mechanism: 2011 年 3 月 11 日東北地方太平洋近海地震發生時，晴空塔已接近完成高度，天線塔仍在頂升階段；地震後塔體接受全面檢查，業主公開表示人員安全、結構無損，一週後的 3 月 18 日達到 634 m。施工中的結構與完工狀態不同：阻尼器可能尚未全部連接、臨時支承仍在、上部有移動中的構件，因此地震後的檢查必須以當時的施工狀態為基準，而不是以完工設計為基準。~When the Tōhoku earthquake struck on 11 March 2011, Skytree was close to full height with the antenna mast still being lifted; the tower was fully inspected afterwards, the owner announced that workers were safe and the structure undamaged, and it reached 634 m a week later on 18 March. A structure under construction differs from the finished state: dampers may not all be connected, temporary supports remain and members at the top may be in motion, so post-earthquake inspection must be based on the construction state at the time, not on the completed design.
units.model: 殘留傾斜判斷：比較地震前後同一時段、相近溫度下的頂部座標，若差值 12 mm、量測高度 600 m，傾角 12/600,000 = 1/50,000；若量測不確定度為 ±15 mm，差值小於兩倍不確定度，可判定沒有可量測的殘留變形。數值為教學假設。~Residual tilt check: compare top coordinates before and after the earthquake at the same time of day and similar temperature; a 12 mm difference at 600 m is a tilt of 12/600,000 = 1/50,000, and with a survey uncertainty of ±15 mm the change is below twice the uncertainty, so no measurable residual deformation is concluded. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 依事先訂好的地震後檢查清單，優先檢查臨時支承、頂升設備、已安裝阻尼器與高應力接頭，以目視、超音波與螺栓扭力抽查；同時比對地震前後的測量資料與現場加速度紀錄，確認結構反應在施工階段分析的預期範圍內，才恢復作業。~Follow a pre-agreed post-earthquake checklist, inspecting temporary supports, lifting equipment, installed dampers and highly stressed connections first by visual, ultrasonic and bolt-torque checks; compare pre- and post-earthquake survey data and site acceleration records to confirm the response was within the construction-stage analysis predictions before work resumes.
units.failure: 若只以完工設計檢核地震影響，可能忽略施工中缺少阻尼與臨時支承較弱的狀態，損傷藏在臨時接頭或頂升導引中；沒有地震前的基準測量，事後也無法判斷是否產生殘留變形。~Assessing earthquake effects only against the completed design can overlook the construction state with missing damping and weaker temporary supports, leaving damage hidden in temporary connections or lifting guides; without a pre-earthquake baseline survey, residual deformation cannot be judged afterwards.
units.misconception: 地震後只要外觀沒有明顯損壞，施工中的結構就可以立即復工。~If there is no visible damage after an earthquake, work on an unfinished structure can resume immediately.
units.practice: 施工計畫中要預先寫好地震後的停工門檻（例如現場加速度超過設定值）、檢查清單、負責技師與復工簽認程序，並定期保存基準測量資料，以便事件後立即比對。~Write post-earthquake stop thresholds such as a site acceleration above a set value, a checklist, the responsible engineer and the restart sign-off procedure into the construction plan in advance, and keep baseline surveys up to date for immediate comparison after an event.

units.anchor: 冬季結冰與落冰~Winter icing and ice fall
units.title: 高聳塔體的結冰、落冰與周邊防護~Icing, ice fall and perimeter protection on a tall tower
units.mechanism: 晴空塔在 2012 年 2 月完工前後與 2013 年 1 月，曾有雪與冰塊從塔身掉落，損壞鄰近倉庫屋頂並打穿民宅屋頂，成為營運上的結構安全議題。高空溫度低、風大，雪與冰會附著在鋼管與平台上，氣溫回升或強風時成片剝落，從數百公尺高處落下。冰塊的危險取決於其質量與終端速度：較大的冰塊受空氣阻力的影響較小，落地時速度與能量都很高，足以穿透屋頂。~In February 2012, around completion, and again in January 2013, snow and ice fell from Skytree, damaging nearby warehouse roofs and holing a house roof, making ice an operational structural-safety issue. At height it is cold and windy, so snow and ice cling to tubes and platforms and shed in sheets when temperatures rise or wind strengthens, falling from hundreds of metres. The hazard depends on the ice's mass and terminal velocity: larger pieces are less slowed by air drag and land with high speed and energy, enough to penetrate a roof.
units.model: 終端速度 v_t = √(2mg/(ρ·C_d·A))。冰塊 m = 2 kg、迎風面積 A = 0.02 m²、C_d = 1.0：v_t = √(2×2×9.81/(1.225×1.0×0.02)) ≈ 40 m/s，動能 ½·m·v² ≈ 0.5×2×40² = 1,600 J；若無空氣阻力，自 300 m 落下速度約 77 m/s。數值為教學假設。~Terminal velocity v_t = √(2mg/(ρ·C_d·A)). For a 2 kg piece of ice with A = 0.02 m² and C_d = 1.0, v_t = √(2×2×9.81/(1.225×1.0×0.02)) ≈ 40 m/s and its kinetic energy is ½·m·v² ≈ 0.5×2×40² = 1,600 J; without drag it would reach about 77 m/s after falling 300 m. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以氣象資料與現場觀測記錄結冰高度、厚度與剝落時機，配合風向推估落冰範圍並繪製危險區地圖；檢查周邊屋頂與遮棚的抗衝擊能力，並在降雪後巡檢塔身易積冰部位，必要時以融雪或除冰設施處理。~Record icing height, thickness and shedding timing from weather data and site observation, estimate the fall zone with wind direction to map hazard areas, check the impact resistance of nearby roofs and canopies, and inspect ice-prone parts of the tower after snowfall, using snow-melting or de-icing measures where needed.
units.failure: 若沒有落冰預警與管制，冰塊可能擊中行人或車輛，造成人命傷亡與第三人損害；長期附冰也會增加構件重量與受風面積，並在融化再凍結時讓水滲入接縫，加速腐蝕。~Without ice-fall warnings and controls, ice can strike pedestrians or vehicles, causing injuries and third-party damage; long-term icing also adds weight and wind area to members and lets meltwater refreeze in joints, accelerating corrosion.
units.misconception: 落冰只是維護清潔問題，和結構工程無關。~Falling ice is only a cleaning issue and has nothing to do with structural engineering.
units.practice: 營運手冊要包含結冰預警條件、周邊管制區範圍、遮棚與屋頂防護規格，以及降雪後的巡檢路線；每次落冰事件都記錄位置與冰塊大小，回饋給結構與設施管理單位修正防護範圍。~The operations manual should include icing warning conditions, the exclusion zone, specifications for canopies and roof protection, and post-snowfall inspection routes; record the location and size of every ice-fall event and feed it back to the structural and facilities teams to adjust the protected area.

units.anchor: 鋼管塔防蝕塗裝~Corrosion coating of the tube tower
units.title: 鋼管塔的防蝕塗裝與長期維護~Coating and long-term upkeep of a tubular steel tower
units.mechanism: 晴空塔的鋼構塗以名為「SKYTREE White」的原創顏色，以傳統藍染中最淡的「藍白」為基調，在白色中加入淡淡的藍。對結構工程師而言，塗裝不只是外觀，而是鋼構防蝕的第一道防線；634 m 的格構塔有大量相貫接頭、平台與排水死角，雨水與結露容易積在接頭與構件交會處。圓管外表面容易塗裝，但封閉的管內必須確實密封或另做防蝕，否則內部腐蝕無法目視發現。~Skytree's steelwork is painted in an original colour called SKYTREE White, based on aijiro, the palest shade of traditional indigo dyeing, with a faint blue added to white. For the structural engineer the coating is not just appearance but the first line of corrosion protection; a 634 m lattice tower has many intersecting joints, platforms and drainage dead spots where rain and condensation collect. The outside of a round tube is easy to coat, but the inside of a closed tube must be reliably sealed or separately protected, otherwise internal corrosion cannot be seen.
units.model: 鋼材腐蝕損失 = 年腐蝕率 × 年數。若塗膜失效後裸鋼以 0.03 mm/年腐蝕，30 年單面損失約 0.9 mm；對 100 mm 厚的主管影響不到 1%，但 12 mm 厚的節點板兩面腐蝕共 1.8 mm，斷面損失達 15%。數值為教學假設。~Section loss = annual corrosion rate × years. If bare steel corrodes at 0.03 mm per year after the coating fails, 30 years remove about 0.9 mm per face; that is under 1% of a 100 mm main tube but, on a 12 mm gusset corroding on both faces, 1.8 mm or 15% of the section. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 定期以膜厚計、附著力試驗與目視分級檢查塗膜，優先抽查相貫接頭、平台積水處與高空不易到達的部位；封閉鋼管以內部濕度監測或抽樣開孔檢查確認密封有效，結果寫入以構件編號管理的維護資料庫。~Inspect coatings periodically with film-thickness gauges, adhesion tests and visual grading, prioritising intersecting joints, ponding spots on platforms and hard-to-reach high areas; confirm closed tubes are still sealed by internal humidity monitoring or sample inspection openings, recording results in a maintenance database indexed by member number.
units.failure: 若只在容易到達的低處補漆，高處接頭與平台下方的腐蝕可能持續數十年未被發現；薄節點板與螺栓先腐蝕變薄，會成為整座塔的弱點，而主管看起來仍完好。~Touching up only easily reached low areas can leave corrosion at high joints and under platforms undetected for decades; thin gussets and bolts thin first and become the tower's weak points while the main tubes still look sound.
units.misconception: 主鋼管很厚，所以腐蝕對鋼管塔沒有影響。~The main tubes are very thick, so corrosion does not matter for a tube tower.
units.practice: 交接文件要包含塗裝系統規格、顏色配方、各部位膜厚紀錄、檢查週期與高空作業通道圖；維護計畫依部位分級訂出檢查頻率，薄構件與接頭列為最高優先，並編列定期重塗的經費與時程。~Handover documents include the coating specification, colour formula, film-thickness records by location, inspection intervals and high-access routes; the maintenance plan grades locations by inspection frequency, puts thin members and joints at highest priority, and budgets and schedules periodic recoating.

example: 三腳塔腳柱受力練習：底部為邊長 s = 68 m 的正三角形，三支腳柱到形心距 R = s/√3 ≈ 39.3 m。若風造成的傾覆彎矩 M = 3,000 MN·m 作用於平行某一邊的軸，對應頂點腳柱的軸力變化 F₁ = M/(1.5R) ≈ 3,000/58.9 ≈ 50.9 MN，另兩腳各 F₂ = M/(3R) ≈ 25.5 MN、方向相反。設總重 400 MN、每腳 133.3 MN：頂點腳柱減壓後剩 133.3 − 50.9 ≈ 82.4 MN，另兩腳增為約 158.8 MN；風向反轉時頂點腳約 184.3 MN、另兩腳約 107.9 MN。若地震垂直加速度使重力暫時減少 30%，頂點腳只剩 0.7×133.3 − 50.9 ≈ 42.4 MN。若底邊縮為 50 m，R ≈ 28.9 m、F₁ ≈ 69.3 MN，頂點腳剩約 64.1 MN，餘裕明顯縮小。由此可見基底寬度與節狀壁樁的拉拔能力為何同樣重要。數值為教學假設，不代表東京晴空塔的設計值。~Tripod leg forces: the base is an equilateral triangle with side s = 68 m, so each leg is R = s/√3 ≈ 39.3 m from the centroid. An overturning moment M = 3,000 MN·m about an axis parallel to one side changes the apex leg force by F₁ = M/(1.5R) ≈ 3,000/58.9 ≈ 50.9 MN and the other two legs by F₂ = M/(3R) ≈ 25.5 MN each in the opposite sense. With a total weight of 400 MN, 133.3 MN per leg, the apex leg drops to 133.3 − 50.9 ≈ 82.4 MN while the other two rise to about 158.8 MN; with the wind reversed the apex leg carries about 184.3 MN and the others about 107.9 MN. If vertical earthquake acceleration briefly reduces gravity by 30%, the apex leg keeps only 0.7×133.3 − 50.9 ≈ 42.4 MN. With a 50 m base side, R ≈ 28.9 m and F₁ ≈ 69.3 MN, leaving the apex leg about 64.1 MN, a clearly reduced margin. This is why base width and the uplift capacity of the knuckle wall piles matter equally. Values are teaching assumptions, not Tokyo Skytree's design values.
history: 東京晴空塔由東武鐵道（經其子公司東武塔晴空塔）開發，日建設計負責設計、大林組承攬施工，目的在取代東京鐵塔作為關東地區的主要電視與廣播發射塔，因為都心高樓增加後需要更高的發射點。2008 年 7 月動工，2011 年 3 月在東日本大地震一週後達到 634 m，同年 11 月獲金氏世界紀錄認證為世界最高的塔，2012 年 2 月完工、5 月開放。其心柱制振概念取自日本五重塔的中心柱，並結合現代油壓阻尼器、鋼管桁架與節狀壁樁基礎。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。~Tokyo Skytree was developed by Tobu Railway through its subsidiary Tobu Tower Skytree, designed by Nikken Sekkei and built by Obayashi, to replace Tokyo Tower as the main television and radio transmitter for the Kantō region once taller buildings in central Tokyo required a higher broadcasting point. Work began in July 2008, the tower reached 634 m in March 2011 a week after the Great East Japan Earthquake, Guinness World Records certified it as the world's tallest tower that November, and it was completed in February 2012 and opened in May. Its central-column vibration control draws on the central pillar of Japanese five-storey pagodas, combined with modern oil dampers, a tubular steel truss and knuckle-wall foundations. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.
facts: 塔高 634 m，2011 年 11 月 17 日獲金氏世界紀錄認證為世界最高的塔~The tower is 634 m tall and was certified by Guinness World Records as the world's tallest tower on 17 November 2011
觀景台分別位於約 350 m 與 450 m~Observation decks sit at about 350 m and 450 m
底部為邊長約 68 m 的正三角形，高寬比約 9：1~The base is an equilateral triangle with sides of about 68 m, giving a slenderness of about 9 to 1
最粗鋼管直徑約 2.3 m、厚約 10 cm~The largest steel tubes are about 2.3 m in diameter and about 10 cm thick
鋼筋混凝土心柱直徑約 8 m，約 125 m 以下與鋼塔固結，125 m 至 375 m 以油壓阻尼器連接~The concrete central column is about 8 m across, fixed to the tower below about 125 m and linked by oil dampers from 125 m to 375 m
公開資料稱心柱制振可減少地震反應約 40% 至 50%~Public sources credit the central-column system with about 40% to 50% less seismic response
節狀壁樁基礎深約 50 m~The knuckle-wall pile foundations reach about 50 m deep
兩組合計約 100 t 的調諧質量阻尼器隨天線塔頂升至塔頂~Two tuned mass dampers totalling about 100 t were lifted to the top with the antenna mast
公開資料記載總工程費約 650 億日圓~Public sources put the construction cost at about 65 billion yen

timeline.event: 7 月 14 日動工，展開三支腳柱的節狀壁樁基礎~Groundbreaking on 14 July, starting the knuckle-wall foundations of the three legs
12 月起在中央豎井內逐段頂升天線塔~From December the antenna mast is jacked up in stages inside the central shaft
3 月 11 日地震後全面檢查，3 月 18 日達到 634 m~Fully inspected after the 11 March earthquake, the tower reaches 634 m on 18 March
11 月 17 日獲金氏世界紀錄認證為世界最高的塔~Certified by Guinness World Records as the world's tallest tower on 17 November
2 月 29 日完工，5 月 22 日對外開放~Completed on 29 February and opened to the public on 22 May
